Building an Indian manufacturer’s international reputation

Supporting market growth through sustained visibility, industry engagement and customer experience.

The objective

Help an Indian manufacturer of twin-screw extrusion machinery strengthen its international reputation and support expansion, particularly in the United States and Japan.

The business had an established presence in India and offices in both overseas markets. Its next stage of growth called for stronger recognition among prospective customers and a network of agents to support marketing and sales.

Shyam’s contribution

As a partner at a business consulting firm, Shyam was a key member of the team working with company leadership on its reputation and market-growth strategy.

The work combined consistent brand exposure, speaking engagements, trade-show participation and customer engagement. Personalised visits to the company’s experience centre gave prospective customers an opportunity to understand its manufacturing capabilities and assess its machinery first-hand.

The positioning drew on the company’s integrated manufacturing foundation and emphasis on quality and delivery.

The outcome

Between 2014 and 2020, the company strengthened its international visibility and its engagement with prospective customers. According to Shyam, the company’s total revenue doubled over the period.

Shyam contributed to the wider effort by helping company leadership develop its market reputation and sustain engagement with prospective customers. The revenue growth reflected the company’s overall performance, not the consulting work alone.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani’s account.

The experience this brings

Connecting technical strengths with sustained market exposure and direct customer experience.
